# compare previous vs current to see what changed from the MOUSE click
prev = previous_frame
curr = current_frame
def get_nodes(frame):

for nid, n in curr_nodes.items():

    if pn is None:

            changed.append((nid,'diff'))

# print small region ascii around click

print('region 18-23,18-22 curr')
